about: Disease grouping for guided search: show the family head first, then ask which type. Computed from MONDO is_a; index.json is unchanged.

rule.stem: nearest is_a ancestor (in the index) whose core name is contained in the child's
rule.fallback: lowest is_a ancestor (in the index) with >= 2 index rows beneath it
rule.never: blocklisted generic names, ancestors with > 60 index rows beneath, or fewer than 3 is_a steps from the MONDO root
rule.similar_names: index rows containing every core word of the head's name but NOT under the head in MONDO: similar names, different conditions
